title: ReactNative
label: ReactNative
desc: Build native iOS and Android apps from a single React codebase.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Scaffold a project with the Community CLI and start the Metro bundler.

snippets.code:
# Create a new project (React Native Community CLI)
npx @react-native-community/cli@latest init MyApp

cd MyApp
npm start          # start Metro
npm run android    # build and run on an emulator or device
npm run ios        # macOS only, requires Xcode

# Verify the local toolchain: Node, JDK, SDK, Xcode, CocoaPods
npx react-native doctor

sections.title: Components
sections.description: Compose screens from core native-backed components instead of HTML tags.

sections.title: Styling
sections.description: Use StyleSheet objects and flexbox; there is no CSS cascade or stylesheet inheritance.

sections.title: Props
sections.description: Pass data into function components as read-only arguments with defaults.

sections.title: State
sections.description: Keep changing values in hooks; every state update re-renders the component.

sections.title: Lists
sections.description: Render long collections with virtualized lists that recycle rows.

sections.title: Navigation
sections.description: Add stack navigation with React Navigation and pass route params.

snippets.code:
# Core plus the native stack navigator
npm install @react-navigation/native @react-navigation/native-stack
npm install react-native-screens react-native-safe-area-context
npx pod-install   # iOS native dependencies

sections.title: Images
sections.description: Load bundled or remote images; remote sources need explicit dimensions.

sections.title: Gestures
sections.description: Handle taps with Pressable and drags with the gesture-handler worklet API.

sections.title: Local Storage
sections.description: Persist small key-value data with AsyncStorage and serialize objects to JSON.

snippets.code:
npm install @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
npx pod-install   # iOS native dependency

sections.title: Platform Differences
sections.description: Branch on the platform when behavior or sizing differs between iOS and Android.

snippets.code:
src/Header.ios.js      loaded on iOS
src/Header.android.js  loaded on Android
src/Header.js          fallback used by both

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Render components in Jest and assert on what the user can see.

snippets.code: npm install --save-dev jest @testing-library/react-native

sections.title: Build and Release
sections.description: Produce signed Android artifacts with Gradle and an iOS archive with Xcode.

snippets.code:
cd android

# Play Store bundle -> app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
./gradlew bundleRelease

# Standalone APK -> app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
./gradlew assembleRelease

# iOS: install pods, then create a release archive
cd ios && pod install && cd ..
xcodebuild -workspace ios/MyApp.xcworkspace \
  -scheme MyApp \
  -configuration Release \
  -archivePath build/MyApp.xcarchive \
  archive
